implementation_scope: Production orthohmm sources are unchanged between the implementation revision and delivery revision. Original standalone per-dataset sources, exact commands and runtime/input fingerprints remain bound by the admitted individual-effects compiler; no new inference settings are introduced here.
fixed_configuration: Retain the exact admitted matched configuration and per-dataset command records in individual_admission.sources.compiler.reader. No selective reselection, local rescue, jackknife, new thresholds, altered initial-search candidates, benchmark-specific parameter overrides or additional combinations. HMM-supported recruitment and the existing phylogenetic pipeline remain central.
selection_scope: Retain every standalone full-vector point-screen pass as one experimental portfolio. No single generalizable winner or new default is established. Use the same portfolio for any future confirmation panel; do not select per-endpoint winners or favorable families. Existing panels are development-exposed and the small OrthoBench gains have paired-family intervals spanning zero.
measurement_control: projection_recovery:projection_hmmer_score_only is unchanged from projection-only repair and is not a backend-specific improvement or an additional advancing candidate.
failure_policy: Preserve original failed scientific executions and archive-only export failures separately from admitted biological gate failures. Do not revive stopped branches, repeat inference or retune parameters.

postfreeze_confirmation_review.scope: Bounded metadata-only public availability review after this freeze is committed and remotely verified. No new reference assignments, predictions or benchmark scores may be opened without a separate frozen dataset/evaluation protocol.
postfreeze_confirmation_review.interpretation: ParaBench's near-total QfO sequence overlap precludes strict input-disjoint confirmation. CGOB's existing sequence overlap and unresolved taxon/ON-OFF/ancestral-reference semantics preclude an independence claim; do not turn the nonmatching remainder into a surrogate independent panel. Metadata failures establish only those endpoint observations, not the absence of all public benchmarks. Fresh simulator seeds would test the simulator, not independent biological generalization.
postfreeze_confirmation_review.stopping_rule: After the six bounded requests and current exposure/provenance checks, document any unavailable or unadmitted confirmation data as nonblocking claim limitations. Do not begin an unbounded archive hunt or contact authors. A newly accessible archive alone does not establish release-matched complete backgrounds, reference semantics, licensing or independence; any actual evaluation needs its own prespecified admission protocol.

final_recommendation_scope: Keep production defaults unchanged. Retain the three frozen standalone options as experimental and preserve the bounded negative results. Do not claim universal superiority to OrthoFinder, statistical equivalence/inferiority, independent confirmation or improvements across all metrics.
